name: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd.
description: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated is a gold-antimony explorer and developer formed in January 2025 from the merger of Mawson Gold Ltd. (TSXV) and Southern Cross Gold Ltd. (ASX), focused on the 100%-owned Sunday Creek epizonal gold-antimony project located 60 km north of Melbourne, Victoria. Sunday Creek has emerged as one of the most significant gold and antimony discoveries in the Western world, with 66 drill intersections exceeding 100 g/t AuEq×m from 84 km of drilling. The company is advancing toward mine development with Australia's largest pre-development drilling program of 22 active rigs.
